ordinary_frame.basis: This source appoints two Lessons, each followed by its own Gradual, between the Collect and Gospel. The generic Ordinary frame has no repeated-reading module, and the Order-of-Mass inventory explicitly leaves the later Ember chants unplaced. A specialized frame has not yet been modeled, so the generic frame is withheld without treating any of these source rows as absent.

Misericordiae tuae remediis, quaesumus, Domine, fragilitas nostra subsistat:

nostrum.

propers.text:
